framings.text: A human-first board becomes a self-compounding meta harness for the entire agentic software development lifecycle, so you can taste a durable, cohesive, verified final product and judge its effect on the codebase as a restaurateur.

supports.quote: a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness
its a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.

framings.text: The system carries work from a brain dump, prompt, hunch, or intuition through rigorous coordination and verification to a PR ready for human review, while considering codebase health and making the next change easier.

supports.quote: it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human
that has the rigor and durability and cohesive and verification that all 'just work's and thinks about the future of any code base it works on.
that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier.

outcome: You experience a human-first board and meta harness that turns a brain dump, prompt, hunch, or intuition into a durable, cohesive, verified PR ready for human review; you remain the restaurateur who tastes the final delicious product, including whether it considers codebase health and makes the next change easier.

questions.text: Should “compounds itself” primarily mean the meta harness improves through use, the codebase becomes easier to change, or both?
